Cleaning a telescope mirror is an essential part of maintaining clear and accurate observations. Use a soft, lint-free cloth or a microfiber towel to gently wipe the mirror surface. Avoid using any abrasive materials or chemicals that could scratch or damage the mirror. A small amount of distilled water or a specialized telescope cleaner can be used, but always follow the manufacturer's instructions. Regular cleaning ensures optimal performance and enhances your viewing experience.  

**P.P.S. Do not forget the spring schedule.**
